images.filename: Lower Town, Harpers Ferry, WV - area view.jpg
images.caption: View of brick buildings in the Lower Town section of Harpers Ferry, West Virginia with Maryland Heights and the B & O Railroad Potomac River Crossing in the background. The Mennen's Borated Talcum Toilet Powder advertisement can be seen on the cliff face. Part of the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park.
images.alt: View of brick buildings in the Lower Town section of Harpers Ferry, West Virginia with Maryland Heights and the B & O Railroad Potomac River Crossing in the background. The Mennen's Borated Talcum Toilet Powder advertisement can be seen on the cliff face. Part of the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park.

images.filename: Winchester and Potomac Railroad Bridge, Harpers Ferry, WV - Appalachian Trail sign.jpg
images.caption: The Winchester and Potomac Railroad Bridge crossing the Potomac River from Harpers Ferry, West Virginia. The Appalachian Trail crosses using the Goodloe E. Byron Memorial Pedestrian Walkway. Considered the "psychological midpoint" of the trail, although the mileage shown is 1,167 miles to Maine and 1,025 miles to Georgia. Part of the historic B & O Railroad Potomac River Crossing.
images.alt: The Winchester and Potomac Railroad Bridge crossing the Potomac River from Harpers Ferry, West Virginia. The Appalachian Trail crosses using the Goodloe E. Byron Memorial Pedestrian Walkway. Considered the "psychological midpoint" of the trail, although the mileage shown is 1,167 miles to Maine and 1,025 miles to Georgia. Part of the historic B & O Railroad Potomac River Crossing.

images.filename: Harper Cemetery, Harpers Ferry, WV - Robert Harper gravesite.jpg
images.caption: Gravesite of Robert Harper (1718–1782) in the Harper Cemetery in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia. The large gravestone on the left in front of the tree and wall. The cemetery is part of the Harpers Ferry Historic District.
images.alt: Gravesite of Robert Harper (1718–1782) in the Harper Cemetery in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia. The large gravestone on the left in front of the tree and wall. The cemetery is part of the Harpers Ferry Historic District.

images.filename: Jefferson Rock, Harpers Ferry, WV - looking east.jpg
images.caption: Jefferson Rock in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia, contributing property of the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park. View to the east shows the steeple of St. Peter's Roman Catholic Church, the Shenandoah River and its confluence with the Potomac River, and the Sandy Hook Bridge.
images.alt: Jefferson Rock in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia, contributing property of the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park. View to the east shows the steeple of St. Peter's Roman Catholic Church, the Shenandoah River and its confluence with the Potomac River, and the Sandy Hook Bridge.
